name: Afonso Ribeiro
bio: Afonso's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing in the hills of northern Portugal. Witnessing the dedication and precision of the teams fueled his ambition. He pursued a degree in engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics, before taking on various roles within smaller racing organizations. He believes in a data-driven approach to racing, emphasizing meticulous preparation and calculated risks. His hands-on experience gives him a comprehensive understanding of the challenges faced by his team.

physical.description: Afonso is a man of average height with a serious demeanor and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on a daily debriefing session, no matter how late the hour.
